DialogCompound

One Copilot Dialog — a modal that interrupts the workflow for a critical action requiring explicit acknowledgement. White surface, radius 24, 28px inset, Shadow/Highest; Title Small (24/28 semibold) + Body Large (16/22) + a right-aligned footer. Three types: Neutral (Cancel + Okay secondary), On Brand (Cancel + Submit feedback primary), and Destructive (Delete subtle-danger + Keep primary). Light and dark. Reuses the Button primitive.
